releaseNotes:
• Quick Chat Reply & Replace (F10): Translate outgoing chat messages in-place with live AI preview, tone selector (Polite/Business, Standard, Casual), and instant replacement via Enter.
• AI Vision Screen Translation (F9): Upgraded to direct multimodal Vision AI with split-view layout, mouse wheel zoom & drag-to-pan controls, and Rich Markdown Preview.
• Improved text capture reliability across Windows 11 browsers and chat applications.
• Standardized clean English UI status indicators and seamless background auto-update.
